packageRules.description: Never manage our own first-party image in the chart's default values. image.tag is intentionally empty so the deployment template resolves it to .Chart.AppVersion; digest-pinning it appends @sha256 to an empty tag and renders a malformed `repo:@sha256:...` reference (InvalidImageName). appVersion already tracks the release.
testcontainers + testcontainers-modules: one PR. The modules crate pins testcontainers to a single 0.x line, so bumping either alone makes cargo fail to resolve.

OpenTelemetry Rust ecosystem: bundle every otel-coupled crate into one PR. Matched by crate name, not source URL: the opentelemetry-rust monorepo crates publish per-subdirectory `repository` deep-links that don't equal the bare repo root, and matchSourceUrls matches exactly. Covers the opentelemetry-rust monorepo, opentelemetry-system-metrics, tracing-opentelemetry, and axum-otel-metrics. 0.x ecosystem upgrades are coordinated breaking changes, so they need a single PR and a manual merge.
Svelte ecosystem: one PR. No forced commit prefix: Renovate uses fix(deps) only when the group includes a runtime member (svelte), and chore(deps) otherwise.

Rust toolchain: the mise pin and the Dockerfile ARG default move together. The ARG is tracked by the customManagers:dockerfileVersions regex preset (# renovate: comment), because a partially interpolated tag like rust:${RUST_VERSION}-slim is invisible to the dockerfile manager. Toolchain upgrades need review.
